description: This file defines the AzureBatchesAPI class, which provides methods to interact with Azure Batch APIs for creating, retrieving, canceling, and listing batch jobs, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AzureBatchesAPI
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage Azure Batch operations such as create, retrieve, cancel, and list batches, supporting both sync and async workflows.

methods.name: acreate_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a batch using the provided Azure client and batch data.

methods.name: create_batch
methods.description: Creates a batch either synchronously or asynchronously based on the _is_async flag, handling client initialization and validation.

methods.name: aretrieve_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves batch details using the provided Azure client.

methods.name: retrieve_batch
methods.description: Retrieves batch details either synchronously or asynchronously, with client validation.

methods.name: acancel_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a batch using the provided Azure client.

methods.name: cancel_batch
methods.description: Cancels a batch either synchronously or asynchronously, with client validation.

methods.name: alist_batches
methods.description: Asynchronously lists batches with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: list_batches
methods.description: Lists batches either synchronously or asynchronously, with client validation.
